era: 2019 Twitch before the 2019-09-26 rebrand: purple #6441a4 top bar in both light and dark, dark #19171c sidebar, #faf9fa light / #0e0c13 dark pages, 4px buttons, Helvetica Neue; the rebrand (new logo, #9147ff, white/black bar) arrived only in the last three months of 2019

sources.shows: signed-out front page: purple #6441a4 top bar (glitch logo, Discover, Browse, Try Prime, ..., dark-purple Search field with the icon inside, Prime crown, Log In outline button, Sign Up, user icon), dark #19171c sidebar with 'Join the Twitch community!' card and Recommended Channels (avatar, name, game, red dot + viewers, Show More), featured carousel, 'Recommended categories' box art with viewers and tags

channel page: channel bar (avatar, name, verified, LIVE, Videos 804, Clips, Events, Followers, Following), purple Follow, grey Subscribe, player, Stream Chat with Send a message and Chat button, stream title and Category; chat input (IMG2343.png): white #fff field with a 1px #dad8de border and 4px corners on the #faf9fa chat footer, grey Send a message placeholder, bits and emote icons inside, purple Chat button below
game directory: box art, title, viewers/followers, Live Channels/Videos/Clips tabs, 'Filter by' tags, Sort by, live cards with LIVE badge, viewer counts, titles, channel, tags
settings: Profile, Twitch Prime, Channel and Videos, Security and Privacy, Notifications, Connections, Recommendations tabs; toggles
chat: badges, emotes, chat settings (Show timestamps, Readable colors, Hide Chat, Popout Chat, name color)

signed-in light theme directory: purple bar with Discover/Following/Browse/Try Prime/..., Search, crown badge, bell, Get Bits, avatar; dark sidebar Followed Channels/Recommended Channels; LIVE cards, viewers, titles, channel, language tags
channel page header with Follow and Subscribe, Videos/Clips/Events/Followers tabs, sidebar 'Join the Twitch community!'
channel bar: Follow (heart), Subscribe, Get Bits, Videos 733, Clips, ..., stream title, game, team, viewers, Share
subscribe dialog: Tier 1 Subscription, benefits, emotes, Subscribe with Prime, Gift

dark mode (Google Images thumbnails of the article's screenshots; the originals are no longer served): purple top bar kept in dark mode, dark sidebar and page, user menu with Dark Mode toggle; gthumb-trishtech-2019-01-3.jpg shows light mode; dark chat input: a near-black field (about #151515) with a thin grey border (about #29282a) under the chat, not the purple search colours
user menu: Get Bits, Online/Invisible, Share my activity, Dark Mode, Channel, Video Producer, Dashboard
